title: Unsupported target mass matters only where the effect is modified
question: When part of the target population lies outside the source trial's support, do weight and covariate diagnostics identify the analyses that fail, or is the modification in the unsupported region, which they cannot see, what decides it?
design: Anchored transport with one covariate truncated in the source; 36 cells crossing unsupported mass, whether the unsupported direction modifies the effect, linear or bent modification and its strength; MAIC, spline G-computation and trimmed G-computation; weight diagnostics and an outcome-informed score scored as classifiers of failure. 1000 replicates per cell.
